{{stub}}

'''SkyRL''' (NovaSky, v0.4.0) provides skyrl-gym tool environments and skyrl-agent for multi-turn RL.<ref>[https://github.com/NovaSky-AI/SkyRL SkyRL repository]</ref> It notably '''implements the Tinker API on your own GPUs'''<ref>[https://docs.skyrl.ai/docs/tinker/overview SkyRL Tinker backend docs]</ref>, so the clean LoRA-RL recipes in Thinking Machines' tinker-cookbook can run at home instead of on their hosted service.<ref>[https://github.com/thinking-machines-lab/tinker-cookbook tinker-cookbook]</ref> It has been used for LoRA RL on a 501B MoE. Spark support is unverified.
